| To retrieve information on a Delaware entity, Key in the name <br> of the entity you are searching. The search results will return both active and <br> inactive entities from our database. This is not an indication of the current <br> status of an entity. The information provided in this application is real time <br> and reflects the information on our database as of the date of the search. When <br> the list of names is returned click the name and the information page will be <br> returned.<br> The entity information provided on this website, free of charge, consists of <br> the entity name, file number, incorporation/formation date, registered agent <br> name, address, phone number and residency.<br> However, additional information can be obtained for a fee.<br> To order a Certificate of Status, or a Certified Copy or Plain copy of a filed document, contact a [Delaware online agent](https://corp.delaware.gov/remoteagts-2/) or submit a request using the [Document Filing and Certificate Request Service](https://corp.delaware.gov/document-upload-service-information/).<br> For more information please read the <br> [Frequently Asked Questions](http://corp.delaware.gov/faqs.shtml) page. |
